data.description:
Each level should be 10 waves. At the end of each level we have a mini-boss. Each level will have a different set of enemy types. Each progressively more difficult than the last. That is Level 1 is easier than level 2. All previous level enemy types can appear in the higher levels (all level 1 enemies can appear in level 2 etc.). When a mini-boss is destroyed the player gets to upgrade any 1 of their existing permanent weapons/power-ups. There are 10 levels before we get to the final boss. We can save the game at each mini-boss and restart rather than starting a new game when returning. When defeating the mini-boss the player can choose an additional weapon type or upgrade that becomes unlocked (50% of them are locked at level 1). We will need at least 10 new aliens and at least 5 new power-ups and 5 new weapon types for the later levels.

Intake interview — Round 1 (blocked on producer answers)

Duplicate check performed — no overlapping completed item found (waves/levels/bosses/epics all completed or unrelated; this item's mini-boss + 10-wave + unlock/save scope is net-new).

## Context found during repo research

- Levels: 10 already exist (MAX_LEVEL=10, BOSS_LEVEL=11). Current campaign has 29 waves total (2-4 per level; L1=2, L3=3, L6=4, L10=2), driven by src/data/difficulty-curves.csv + LEVELS in src/waves/Formations.ts.
- Enemies: 17 archetypes ship today (scout, diver, tank, phaser, swarm, asteroid, harvester + classic-arcade march, capturer, ghost-chase/ambush/flank/wander, grunt, raider, lane-traffic, orbital-strike). Levels 6-10 already showcase the classic-arcade roster (AH-0MV29SBAQ000HQR2).
- Power-ups: 11 (shield, bomb, speed_boost, phase_shift, teleport, extra_life, magnet, mineral_scoop, smart_bomb, force_field, mystery_ufo).
- Weapons: 11 (cannon, spread, dual, rapid, wave_laser, ricochet, cluster, options, nova, mortar, arc).
- A permanent/temporary level split already exists (powerUpLevels.ts, AH-0MUX802450085VZZ / AH-0MUX9T7C7003CBQP): hold-full rewards raise the permanent level for the run. A reusable choice overlay exists (MineralChoiceScene + powerups/choice) — natural basis for the mini-boss upgrade choice.
- No mini-boss concept, no weapon/power-up unlock gating, and no run checkpoint/save (only settings/leaderboard/rules persist to localStorage). All three are net-new subsystems.
- Gym↔game parity (AGENTS.md) requires any new enemy/mini-boss behaviour to be mirrored in the gym scenes.

## Questions (Q1-Q3; recommended option marked)

**Q1 — 'At least 10 new aliens, 5 new power-ups, 5 new weapon types for the later levels': is that measured against the current catalogue or net-new beyond today?**
- A (Recommended): Count the EXISTING catalogue toward the targets — the classic-arcade roster already provides later-level enemy variety (8+ archetypes for levels 6-10), so this epic's focus is systems (10-wave levels, mini-bosses, upgrade/unlock, save) plus filling any genuine gaps. Rationale: avoids re-building content that already exists.
- B: Require 10 net-new alien archetypes + 5 net-new power-ups + 5 net-new weapons BEYOND today's 17/11/11 (mini-boss archetypes may count toward the 10). Rationale: strict reading of the description.
- C: Freeform.

**Q2 — Mini-boss placement and design: is the mini-boss the 10th wave or an encounter after 10 regular waves? One shared mini-boss scaled per level, or bespoke per-level mini-bosses?**
- A (Recommended): After the level's 10 regular waves there is a distinct mini-boss phase (mirroring the existing after-Level-10 final-boss pattern); a small set of reusable mini-boss archetypes (2-3 designs, e.g. scaled variants of existing enemies with extra HP/patterns) is assigned per level and grows in difficulty. Rationale: 10 bespoke 4-phase mini-boss designs is a large content epic; reusing the multi-phase Boss architecture keeps parity and scope bounded.
- B: Mini-boss IS the 10th wave (9 regular + 1 boss wave per level); bespoke mini-boss per level (10 designs).
- C: Freeform.

**Q3 — Reward + save model: reconcile the two reward sentences and the checkpoint requirement.**
- A (Recommended): Each mini-boss defeat grants the player ONE choice — either upgrade any 1 of their existing permanent weapons/power-ups by one level, OR unlock a new weapon type from the locked pool; ~50% of the weapon/power-up catalogue is locked at level 1 and becomes available via these mini-boss rewards. A checkpoint is auto-saved at each mini-boss (persisting level, lives, score, minerals, permanent upgrade levels, unlocked weapons via localStorage key alongside settings/leaderboard) and the main menu offers Continue/resume from the last checkpoint instead of only New Game. Rationale: matches both reward sentences read together (upgrade existing OR unlock new), and the existing permanent-level + choice-overlay machinery.
- B: Two separate rewards per mini-boss (an upgrade AND an unlock both granted).
- C: Freeform.

Open to any freeform refinement of the above. Once answered, the intake brief (problem, users, ACs, key files, effort/risk) will be drafted and the item advanced to intake_complete.
